USED VEHICLE PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Used Vehicle Purchase Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into on March 14, 2026 between Valley Auto Sales LLC, a licensed motor vehicle dealer ("Dealer"), and Chris Tanaka ("Buyer").

1. Vehicle. Dealer sells and Buyer buys the following used vehicle (the "Vehicle"): 2019 Honda Civic LX sedan, silver; vehicle identification number (VIN) 2HGFC2F69KH512345; odometer reading at the time of sale 61,240 miles, which Dealer certifies is the actual mileage to the best of its knowledge.

2. Price. The cash price of the Vehicle is $17,900.00. Added to it are state sales tax of $1,163.50, a title and registration fee of $148.00 paid to the state, and a dealer documentary fee of $199.00. The total price is $19,410.50.

3. Trade-In and Payment. Dealer credits Buyer $4,000.00 for Buyer's trade-in vehicle, a 2012 Toyota Corolla, which Buyer states is free of liens. Buyer has paid a deposit of $500.00. The balance of $14,910.50 is due in certified funds at delivery.

4. Warranty. Dealer warrants the engine, transmission and drive axle of the Vehicle for 30 days or 1,000 miles after delivery, whichever comes first, and will pay 100% of the parts and labor to repair a covered failure. All other parts of the Vehicle are sold as is, with no dealer warranty.

5. Window Form. The information you see on the window form for this vehicle is part of this contract. Information on the window form overrides any contrary provisions in the contract of sale.

6. Title. Dealer warrants that it owns the Vehicle and will transfer title to Buyer free of all liens and encumbrances. Dealer will deliver the signed certificate of title to Buyer, or file it with the state for Buyer, within 20 days after delivery.

7. Delivery. Buyer takes delivery of the Vehicle at Dealer's lot on March 14, 2026, and risk of loss passes to Buyer at that time.

8. Cancellation. If Buyer does not pay the balance at delivery, Dealer may cancel this Agreement, return the trade-in vehicle, and keep the deposit.

9. Entire Agreement. This Agreement and the window form are the whole agreement between Dealer and Buyer. No statement by a salesperson changes it unless it is written here.

VALLEY AUTO SALES LLC
